summary: Cache homepage data reads (listTraditions, listPublished) + trim full content from list SELECT, to absorb bot traffic on /
description: The homepage is force-dynamic and runs listPublished(3)+listTraditions() per request; bots hitting / repeat identical DB work. Fix: (1) wrap both reads in Next's data cache (unstable_cache) — traditions revalidate ~1h tag corpus-traditions; published posts revalidate ~5m tag published-posts, busted via revalidateTag in the publish/archive routes so new essays appear instantly. (2) Stop SELECTing full essay content in listPublished — now that a dek column exists, select title/slug/dek + left(content,300) for the legacy fallback only. getPublishedBySlug (post page) keeps full content. Edge Cache-Control at Cloudflare deferred as a follow-on.
